topic: The Magic of Superposition: Exploring Quantum States

sections.title: Introduction: The Binary Limit
lecture_lines: Classical bits are strictly zero or one.
[Asset: switch_on_off] Like a simple light switch.
Quantum states exist in both at once.
animations: Fade in 'Introduction: The Binary Limit' text, color #FFFFFF.

Show a question mark appearing between the dots.
Final state: Title and dots remain on screen.

sections.title: The Concept of Superposition
lecture_lines: A qubit is a weighted sum: |ψ⟩ = α|0⟩ + β|1⟩.
[Asset: spinning_coin] Think of a spinning, blurry coin.
It is a blend of basis states.
[Asset: vector_2d] Represented as a vector on a plane.
Coefficients determine the state's orientation.
animations: Display a wave representing superposition, featuring a gold [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coin.svg] floating within the wave.
Animate the wave moving between two states.
Add a probability distribution curve underneath.
Highlight the peak of the probability curve.
Fade out wave, leaving final probability distribution with the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coin.svg] resting at the peak.

sections.title: Measurement and Wavefunction Collapse
lecture_lines: Measurement forces a definite state outcome.
[Asset: cat_box] Schrödinger's cat is both alive and dead.
Observation collapses the quantum wavefunction.
[Asset: probability_graph] Likelihoods defined by |α|² and |β|².
The outcome is purely probabilistic.
animations: Show a generic wavefunction representation with a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png] sitting nearby.
Introduce a 'measurement' operator as a vertical line.
Animate the line crossing the wavefunction.
Show the wavefunction collapsing to a single spike.
Fade out original wave, leaving the collapsed state inside a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/box.svg].

sections.title: Visualizing Quantum States: The Bloch Sphere
lecture_lines: The Bloch sphere visualizes all qubit states.
[Asset: north_south_poles] North is |0⟩; South is |1⟩.
[Asset: equator_superposition] The equator holds equal 50/50 mixtures.
Any surface point is a valid state.
Global geometry maps the quantum possibilities.

Display a state vector starting at the north pole of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg].

sections.title: Application and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Superposition enables massive quantum parallelism.
[Asset: maze_solver] Explore all maze paths simultaneously.
Exponentially faster than classical computing.
